mapper.insert: INSERT INTO online_game_results (game_type, member_id, nickname, player_count, won, played_at) VALUES (#{gameType}, #{memberId}, #{nickname}, #{playerCount}, #{won}, #{playedAt})

INSERT INTO solo_game_records (game_code, difficulty, member_id, nickname, score, elapsed_seconds, moves, played_at) VALUES (#{gameCode}, #{difficulty}, #{memberId}, #{nickname}, #{score}, #{elapsedSeconds}, #{moves}, #{playedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT grouped.member_id, COALESCE(member.member_name, grouped.guest_name) AS player_name, grouped.wins, grouped.plays FROM ( SELECT game_result.member_id, CASE WHEN game_result.member_id IS NULL THEN game_result.nickname END AS guest_name, SUM(CASE WHEN game_result.won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM online_game_results game_result WHERE game_result.game_type = #{gameCode}
GROUP BY game_result.member_id, guest_name ) grouped LEFT JOIN members member ON member.member_id = grouped.member_id ORDER BY grouped.wins DESC, grouped.plays ASC, player_name ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT best.member_id, COALESCE(member.member_name, best.guest_name) AS player_name, best.score, best.elapsed_seconds, best.moves, best.played_at FROM ( SELECT solo_record.member_id, CASE WHEN solo_record.member_id IS NULL THEN solo_record.nickname END AS guest_name, solo_record.score, solo_record.elapsed_seconds, solo_record.moves, solo_record.played_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY solo_record.member_id, CASE WHEN solo_record.member_id IS NULL THEN solo_record.nickname END ORDER BY ) AS player_order FROM solo_game_records solo_record WHERE solo_record.game_code = #{gameCode} AND solo_record.difficulty = #{difficulty}
) best LEFT JOIN members member ON member.member_id = best.member_id WHERE best.player_order = 1 ORDER BY LIMIT #{limit}
